summary: Frontend-only test of the MPA soft warnings and the 'Meals (N) from <list>' heading, as the Pro user at 390x844 plus one desktop screenshot. 17/17 checks passed. Trip duration not set ('Not set, using 1 day'), built-in Meal Plan: mpa-warning-count reads '21 meals are picked for a 1-day trip, which allows up to 3 (3 a day).' and mpa-warning-types reads 'No desserts, snacks found in the meal names.'. Go back and Escape each close only the warning; the MPA dialog stays open and no list is made. Make it anyway creates the MPA Shopping List with first row 'Meals (21) from Meal Plan'. Trip 7 days, Meal Plan: only the types warning shows. A custom list whose meal names cover breakfast, lunch, dinner, dessert and snack (5 meals) makes the list with no popup, heading 'Meals (5) from TEST_Kids Meals'. Meal Plan + Kids (26 meals, 7 days) shows only the count warning (26 > 21) and gives 'Meals (26) from Meal Plan, TEST_Kids Meals'. A single 'Brunch eggs' list counts as a breakfast. The warning dialog fits 390px (left 11, right 378) and looks fine once its fade-in finishes.

issues: The amber-50 warning rows are very faint on the white dialog. A slightly stronger tint or an amber left border would help (cosmetic).

critical_code_review_comments: mpaWarnings: when trip_days is not set the count warning says '1-day trip' but gives no hint to set Trip duration in Additional boat details. Consider adding that hint (optional).
MEAL_TYPES matching uses meal names only: a meal named e.g. 'Pasta' with no type word counts toward none. This is expected by design but may cause frequent types warnings for user lists.
seed_data_creation: Via /app/tests/mpa_seed.py (direct Mongo): set trip_days, added TEST_Kids Meals and TEST_Extra Meals lists. All cleaned with 'clean': TEST lists and the generated MPA Shopping List removed, trip_days restored to 0 (original).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pro boat original trip_days = 0 and it has no MPA Shopping List. Use 'python3 /app/tests/mpa_seed.py days N | lists | clean' to seed or restore. The list selector is a native select (data-testid list-selector); select_option('mealPlan'). Untick mpa-aisles-check and mpa-provisions-check to avoid AI calls. Wait about 1s after the warning dialog opens before taking a screenshot (fade-in animation).
